feedback.worked_solution:
Recall that the equation of an elliptic cylinder whose axis of symmetry is the $z$-axis is given by

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Thus, an elliptic cylinder whose axis of symmetry is the $y$**-axis** is given by

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{{c}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, our equation is an elliptic cylinder whose axis of symmetry is the $y$-axis and $a=\frac{1}{2},\,c=1.$
